I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261 seats. That's the number Ilse posted in #north-team on Oct 14.

I also pointed out that the 185 seats Dana posted in August 2025 was the Amendment No. 1 count, not the renewal. I couldn't check 261 against anything signed because there are no Quarrendon account files I can see. So I suggested she confirm with Ilse if the tracker needs a signed source.

Separately, my Oct 14 note confirming Ilse's figure ended up posted in #north-team as its own message. It only repeats the 261-seat count, so nothing sensitive leaked.
